instructions.text: Dissolve the flour in cold milk and see that it is free from lumps
Whisk the butter and sugar to a cream and add to it a pinch of salt
Mix together half a pint of milk, one egg and the flour
Stir this into the butter and add a dash of nutmeg, or any flavor
Heat until near the boiling point and serve

source.author: F.L. Gillette
source.originalInstructions:
1. Dissolve the flour in cold milk and see that it is free from lumps
2. Whisk the butter and sugar to a cream and add to it a pinch of salt
3. Mix together half a pint of milk, one egg and the flour
4. Stir this into the butter and add a dash of nutmeg, or any flavor
5. Heat until near the boiling point and serve
